pages.text: $(italic)Ranged investment. Best for Ranger and Samurai.$()$(br2)28 nodes: an 8-node trunk, then two branches of 10, each ending in a capstone. Every node costs 1 point, the capstones too.$(br2)Most nodes are attributes and apply at once. Hawk Eye catches up within 10 seconds; the execute, splash and refund nodes act on each hit.

pages.title: Trunk
pages.text: $(bold)Steady Aim$() I and II: +5% ranged damage each$(br)$(bold)Quick Hands$() I and II: +5% attack speed each$(br)$(bold)Hawk Eye$() I and II: +3% ranged damage each$(br)$(bold)Nimble$() I and II: +4% movement speed each$(br2)Attack speed makes melee swings faster; it does not change how fast a bow draws.

pages.title: Sniper Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Steady Shot$() I to IV: +6%, +8%, +8% and +10% ranged damage$(br)$(bold)Penetration$() I to III: +4% ranged resistance shred each$(br)$(bold)Kill Shot$() I and II: +10% damage each against targets under 30% health, on any attack$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Deadeye$(), +15% ranged damage and +8% ranged resistance shred.

pages.title: Volley Branch
pages.text: $(bold)Rapid Fire$() I to IV: +6%, +6%, +8% and +8% attack speed$(br)$(bold)Arrow Conservation$() I to III: each a 5% chance to get an arrow back when a projectile hits$(br)$(bold)Scatter Shot$() I and II: each splashes 5% of a projectile's damage onto monsters within 3 blocks$(br2)$(bold)Capstone: Storm of Arrows$(), +15% attack speed and +10% to both the refund and the splash.
